entities.summary: Luxembourg is a sovereign nation in Western Europe, Europe. Its capital is Luxembourg City. Official languages include Luxembourgish (Lëtzebuergesch), French, German. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy (Grand Duchy). Population: approximately 0.7 million. Area: 2,586 km². historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Luxembourg's neutrality during World War I and its role in maintaining peace helped prevent a wider conflict. Its independence and membership in the Benelux union have contributed to regional stability.
